from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyLeaseInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted lease liability information for a single company from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company reported in the document")
    current_lease_liability: float | None = Field(description="Current portion of lease liability, or None if not explicitly reported")
    long_term_lease_liability: float | None = Field(description="Long-term portion of lease liability, or None if not explicitly reported")
    total_lease_liability: float | None = Field(description="Total lease liability explicitly stated in the document, or None if not explicitly reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the amounts reported, e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period of the financial statement")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyLeaseInfo]
